analogy.rationale: Hemostatic agents act on coagulation factors and platelets, targets not expressed as a transcriptional program in these cell lines, so they should produce little or no mRNA response. The closest listed classes are ion-channel/cardiac drugs that also lack a coherent transcriptional signature in these cells.
